items.message: Classified as 'imported' (not yet implemented). The Apollo Lunar Excursion Module (LEM) Eagle is a highly detailed, historically accurate spacecraft model with complex geometry including gold-foil-wrapped octagonal descent stage, angled landing legs, an angular asymmetric ascent stage, a round hatch, and multiple antennas — far too many irregular, non-primitive details and surface treatments to approximate with CSG scripting. The realistic gold foil and gray paneling visual style further demands a professionally modeled and textured imported asset rather than a procedurally constructed one. 5 candidate(s) found -- approve one in the review app (match not specific enough for unattended download).
